tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a student who recently completed an internship at a local company. You want to send an email to your supervisor, Mr. Clark, to thank him for the opportunity and to ask for a letter of recommendation for your future job applications. Write an email to Mr. Clark.
bullets: Express your appreciation for the internship opportunity and describe what you learned under his mentorship.
Explain how the experience will benefit your future career.
tasks.subject: Request for letter of recommendation
